keyLimits.en: Unlimited courses, 1 community (5 spaces), 5 digital downloads, basic ecommerce, custom domain, email/chat support only.
Adds live Zoom sessions, completion certificates, graded quizzes, payment plans, memberships, 2 site administrators.
Removes Thinkific branding, 3 communities (20 spaces each), B2B invoicing, API access and webhooks, 6 administrators.
Dedicated support, AI teaching assistant, SSO, SCORM compliance, CRM integrations, 10,000+ user seats, custom roles.

addOns.en: Branded mobile app add-on: $199/month for white-labeled iOS and Android app.

cautions.en: No free plan; only a 30-day trial. The cheapest plan usable for real course sales is Basic at $54/mo (or $40/mo billed annually).

capabilities.en: Drag-and-drop online course builder with video hosting and multimedia content support.
Built-in ecommerce: checkout, coupons, order bumps, payment plans, and multiple payment processors (Thinkific Payments, Stripe, PayPal, Apple/Google Pay).
Community features (spaces), live Zoom sessions, and completion certificates from the Start plan up.

limitations.en: No permanent free plan; every plan is a paid subscription after the 30-day trial.
API access and webhooks are gated behind the Grow plan ($219/mo or $164/mo annual).

reason.en: Direct all-in-one competitor for course creators, bundling marketing tools with course hosting.
Similar course platform with strong customization and branding options.
Simpler, lower-cost alternative for selling courses, memberships and digital downloads.

missingAlternatives.name: Teachable
missingAlternatives.reason: Major direct competitor in the course-hosting space, not present in the catalogue.

unknowns: Exact bandwidth caps per plan (100GB-7,500GB+) were only given as a broad range on the pricing page, not per-plan figures.
